name: MakerDAO
tagline: Decentralized stablecoin protocol behind DAI and Sky.
description: MakerDAO is a decentralized credit protocol that issues the DAI stablecoin against collateralized debt positions, now part of the Sky ecosystem. This listing tracks the Maker Vat core contract on Ethereum to measure on-chain activity. Coverage is limited to the mapped contract and does not represent all protocol activity.
